description: This file is a C source code file implementing utility functions for handling parameters, parsing configuration files, and processing MAC and hex values within a software project related to TR-181 standard in RDK-B (cisco's IoT firmware). It includes functions for parsing configuration files, freeing parameter lists, and converting MAC addresses and hex strings to binary form.

methods.name: int file_parse(char * file_name,param_node ** head)
methods.description: Parses a configuration file to populate a linked list of parameters, extracting specific fields such as MAC addresses and filter lists.

methods.name: void free_paramList(param_node * head)
methods.description: Frees the linked list of parameter nodes to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: int getMac(char * macAddress,int len,unsigned char * mac)
methods.description: Converts a MAC address string into a 6-byte array.

methods.name: int getHex(char * hex_val,unsigned char * hexVal,int hexLen)
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a byte array, supporting specific formatting and length validation.

methods.name: int getHexGeneric(char * hex_val,unsigned char * hexVal,int hexLen)
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a byte array for generic hex input formats.

ctags.name: getMac
ctags.pattern: /^int getMac(char * macAddress, int len, unsigned char * mac)$/
